# These are the 22 galaxies from Cosmicflows-4 (Tully et al. 2023) table2 that have

# maximum rotation velocities from HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014
# Archive date: 2026-08-28. Reference: Makarov et al. 2014
# The potential-equivalent scale is u_phi = vrot / sqrt(2)
# The gravitational potential proxy is U_i = u_phi^2 = vrot^2 / 2.

# are marked with source=EXISTING_CATALOG. The remaining 14 were queried from
# HyperLEDA on 2026-08-28 and are marked source=HYPERLEDA_QUERY_2026-08-28.
